data.name: Singularity Divide
data.detailed_description:
The Singularity fractured the world. Now, survivors rebuild in the ruins while stability and defiance wage war over what humanity becomes next.

Singularity Divide is a post-apocalyptic survival RTS where you're more than just a commander, you're the architect of a Haven in a world split by ideology and force. Scavenge the bones of fallen cities. Manage survivors with unique traits. Navigate influence from Eidolon, the AI network enforcing stability, and the Fractured, a radical human resistance claiming to fight for agency at any cost.

Will your Haven submit to order, rise in defiance, or walk the line between?

Features

Rebuild from Ruin - Convert abandoned structures into greenhouses, watchtowers, factories, and fortified survivor outposts.

Alignment System - Your decisions shape your tech, units, and story direction as Eidolon and the Fractured compete for influence over your settlement.

Escalating Threats - As your Haven grows, so does attention from both sides. The Fractured field enhanced fighters who refuse to stay down. Eidolon responds with calculated countermeasures.

Procedural Derelict Zones - Every run generates new layouts, resource challenges, and strategic dilemmas.

Survival with Consequence - Combat and expansion aren’t just about winning. They determine what your Haven becomes and who you’re willing to become to survive.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-2400 / AMD FX-8320
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 660 / AMD Radeon HD 7870
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-6600K / AMD Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GTX 1060 / AMD RX 580
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 2 GB available space

content_descriptors.notes: This game contains stylized violence, survival scenarios, and thematic elements related to societal collapse and mutant/AI conflict.
